passage:
The topic of the class debate was whether students should have homework on weekends. Many students chose the "no homework" side because it sounded easier.
During preparation, the teacher asked both sides to find strong reasons. The homework side talked about practice and review. The no-homework side talked about rest, family time, and learning outside school.
After the debate, some students changed their opinions. They did not fully agree with the other side, but they understood it better.
The teacher said that was the real goal.
A debate is not only about winning. It is about learning how a reasonable person can think differently from you.
